name: Physical or logical state description code
description: Code specifying a physical or logical state.

values.name: Split
values.description: Split Separated into multiple units.

values.name: Missing
values.description: Missing Absent or lacking.

values.name: Wrong identification
values.description: Wrong identification The actual identification is different from the given identification.

values.name: Damaged
values.description: Damaged In a damaged state.

values.name: Good condition
values.description: Good condition In a state of good condition.

values.name: Wrong product
values.description: Wrong product The product is wrong.

values.name: On hold
values.description: On hold Held, awaiting further action.

values.name: Proposed
values.description: Proposed The object is in a proposed state.

values.name: Accepted
values.description: Accepted The object is in an accepted state.

values.name: Scheduled
values.description: Scheduled The object is in a scheduled state.

values.name: Completed
values.description: Completed The object is in a completed state.

values.name: Rejected
values.description: Rejected The object is in a rejected state.

values.name: Postponed
values.description: Postponed The object is in a postponed state.

values.name: Cancelled
values.description: Cancelled The object is in a cancelled state.

values.name: Obsolete
values.description: Obsolete The object is obsolete.

values.name: Fresh
values.description: Fresh Retaining the original properties, not impaired by spoilage or preservation.

values.name: Defective
values.description: Defective The object is defective or faulty.

values.name: Solid
values.description: Solid A substance in the fundamental state of matter that retains its size and shape without need of a container.

values.name: Gas
values.description: Gas Matter in a state where it occupies whatever volume is available.

values.name: Liquid
values.description: Liquid Matter in a state where it maintains a fixed volume but adapts to the shape of its container.
